scope: Server-rendered presentation checks against synthetic persisted record shapes; not browser visual or interaction QA.

results.name: Quality workbench preserves conflicting original/transcribed values and HOLD
Read-only workbench cannot offer an enabled signing action
Map includes saved dependencies and bounded source links with exact revisions
Owner-only role cannot enable reviewer signing in review dock
Audit workspace keeps packet state and human approval requirement visible
Empty quality workspace explains missing source rather than inventing a case
Fresh outcome view contains zero saved counts and directs to originals, never preloads proof
Saved outcome view retains uncertainty and avoids treating historical decisions as approval
Motion model is decorative and does not imply saved facts or approval
